name: Trustco Group Holdings Ltd.

rows.label: Gross Margin (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: Gross Margin (%) = Gross Profit / Revenue x 100

source: Trustco Group Holdings audited consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, financial years ended 31 August. FY2023 and FY2022 read from the 2023 integrated annual report; FY2021 read from the 2022 integrated annual report, which carries FY2021 restated after the JSE proactive monitoring process. | JSEBLOCKED 20 Nov 2026: no audited statements for the financial years ended 31 August 2024 or 31 August 2025 have been published and the shares have been suspended on the JSE since December 2024. The company's SENS update of 1 April 2026 states that completion and publication of those audited statements is still outstanding and is a precondition for applying to lift the suspension, so FY2023 remains the newest audited year. Verified at https://senspdf.jse.co.za/documents/SENS_20260401_S519378.pdf and against the issuer results centre https://www.tgh.na/investors/results-centre, whose newest report is the FY2023 integrated annual report. | CRON 2026-11-20: audited annual financial statements for the years ended 31 August 2024 and 31 August 2025 were still unpublished at the last dated announcement (SENS 1 April 2026, update on Trustco Group audit processes), with the group auditor only being appointed under the simplified JSE Listings Requirements and trading in the shares suspended, so FY2024 and FY2025 cannot be carried
note: Amounts in Namibian dollars; the filings print NAD million and each figure is multiplied by 1000000. Revenue is the issuer's interest revenue plus other revenue (FY2023 64+27, FY2022 26+23, FY2021 70+243). The issuer publishes no operating profit line, so Operating Profit (EBIT) is profit before tax plus net finance costs, which carries fair value movements on investments and the FY2022 gain on deemed disposal of subsidiaries. The FY2021 comparative covers eleven months to 31 August 2021 because the group changed its year end. No cost of sales is printed in FY2023 or FY2022, so Gross Profit is withheld there rather than shown as equal to revenue. Ratios use total assets, total liabilities and total equity from the balance sheet printed with the same statements. FY2021 ROE is withheld: the loss of 917 against equity of 397 exceeds the 200 percent plausibility ceiling, so the ratio is not published.
